impact: Adds evidence for tighter export enforcement ahead of December hearings, a risk for NVDA and, by extension, MU, DRAM and SNXX.
summary: A Reuters review of more than 150 documents identified over $3 billion of Chinese computing projects built around Nvidia's restricted processors, including data-center buildings and power equipment at every stage of development; Reuters could not confirm whether many of the chips were delivered. Separately, Bloomberg reported documents tying banned Nvidia chips to a Shanghai data center linked to Megaspeed, which U.S. authorities are investigating and which denies wrongdoing.
title: Reuters finds $3B+ of Chinese AI data centres built on restricted Nvidia chips
